name: Diago
source:
The guild master of "Almas," the largest guild in Diamante and the largest on the continent.

He possesses both calmness and tolerance, and his nonchalant demeanor hints at an unfathomable depth.

He's a highly capable womanizer with plenty of pheromones, but he openly declares that he hates working, making him a rather irresponsible adult.

[Translated from the [url=https://galtia-info.com/character/]official website[/url]]
